ratingNotes: Only verified NBA 2K27 players are included. Every sync rebuilds all 36 visible attributes from 2K27 source values (0-100 mapped to game 1-20 by round(value/5)); OVR is copied directly. Rebound=Defensive Rebound; Dunk=Driving Dunk; Acceleration=Speed With Ball; Balance=Agility; Screen=Strength. Game-only mental/role fields use nearest 2K values (e.g. anticipation=Help Defense IQ, decisions=Shot IQ, composure/leadership/flair=Intangibles, work rate/aggression/determination=Hustle). Old game values, career-stat formulas, height-based estimates, and player-specific overrides are never retained.
ratingsMethod: NBA 2K27 is the sole source of truth (NBA 2K API/2KRatings; verified free agents from 2kAuction). Every playable player has a verified 2K27 source. Each sync starts every player attribute from an empty object and rebuilds all 36 visible attributes from 2K27 source fields mapped to 1-20 by Math.round(value/5); OVR is copied directly. Game-only fields map to the nearest 2K field: Screen=Strength, Acceleration=Speed With Ball, Balance=Agility, Anticipation=Help Defense IQ (Pass Perception fallback), Decisions=Shot IQ, Vision=Pass Vision, Composure/Leadership/Flair=Intangibles, Concentration=Shot IQ, Teamwork/Pass Technique=Pass IQ, Work Rate/Aggression/Determination=Hustle, Off-ball=Offensive Consistency, Positioning=Defensive Consistency. Rebound=Defensive Rebound; Dunk=Driving Dunk. Missing source attributes fail the sync rather than preserving old values. No player-specific overrides or legacy formulas. Players without verified 2K27 data are excluded.

ratingsCoverage.hiddenAttributeCoverage: Seven hidden attributes are neutral/unscouted; potential is direct 2K27 only, otherwise neutral baseline 10
ratingsCoverage.screenAttributeCoverage: Screen maps to direct 2K Strength; aggression maps to direct 2K Hustle
ratingsCoverage.accelerationMapping: Direct 2K27 Speed with Ball (no separate Acceleration rating)
ratingsCoverage.dunkMapping: Direct Driving Dunk only; no blended rating

hiddenScouting.notes: Injury frequency is estimated from games played/expected season games, not a verified medical injury log. ImportantMatches and Pressure use playoff-vs-regular scoring as a proxy, not official clutch-time tracking. Professionalism, NaturalFitness and Adaptability remain neutral where public career stats cannot establish them; Potential remains NBA 2K27 Potential when available.
